cases.translation: A sower went out to sow.
cases.explain: Сеятель is the subject of вышел (went out) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Другие упали в каменистые места, где было мало плодородной ___.
cases.translation: Others fell on rocky ground, where there was little fertile soil.
cases.explain: The quantity word мало (little) requires the genitive → почвы.

cases.sentence: Иисус сказал Своим ___, переправимся на другую сторону озера.
cases.translation: Jesus said to his disciples, 'Let's cross to the other side of the lake.'
cases.explain: Ученикам is the indirect object (recipient) of сказал (said to) → dative.

cases.sentence: Иисус сказал Своим ученикам, переправимся на другую ___ озера.
cases.translation: Jesus said to his disciples, 'Let's cross to the other side of the lake.'
cases.explain: На marking direction/goal (to the other side) takes the accusative → сторону.

cases.sentence: ...и когда созреет урожай, человек приходит с ___, потому что наступила жатва.
cases.translation: ...and when the crop is ripe, the man comes with a sickle, because the harvest has come.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → серпом.

cases.sentence: ...а Иисус в это время спал на ___, подложив подушку под голову.
cases.translation: ...and Jesus at that time was sleeping in the stern, with a cushion under his head.
cases.explain: На marking location (no motion) takes the prepositional → корме.

reading.ru: Когда он разбрасывал семена, то некоторые из них упали у самой дороги. Прилетели птицы и склевали их».
reading.question: In the parable of the sower, what happened to the seed that fell along the path?
options: It grew into a great tree
reading.explain: The seed that fell on the path was eaten by birds that came and devoured it.

reading.ru: Но семена, которые упали на хорошую почву, взошли, выросли и принесли урожаев тридцать, а то и в шестьдесят, и даже во сто крат больше, чем было посеяно.
reading.question: What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?
options: It produced a crop thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times what was sown
reading.correct: It produced a crop thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times what was sown
reading.explain: The seed sown on good soil grew up and yielded thirty, sixty, and even a hundred times what was sown.

reading.ru: Вам открыта тайна Божьего Царства, а тем, внешним, все дается в притчах, чтобы они смотрели, но не увидели, и слушали, но не поняли, чтобы они не обратились и не были бы прощены».
reading.question: Why did Jesus say he taught outsiders only in parables?
options: So that they would look but not perceive, and hear but not understand
So that they would remember the stories better
Because the disciples asked him to
reading.correct: So that they would look but not perceive, and hear but not understand
reading.explain: Jesus said outsiders receive everything in parables so that they may look but not see, and hear but not understand.

reading.ru: Другие похожи на семена, посеянные на каменистой почве. Эти люди, когда слышат слово, сразу же принимают его с радостью.
reading.question: What do the seeds sown on rocky ground represent?
options: People who receive the word with joy but have no root and fall away
People who never hear the word at all
People who reject the word immediately
reading.correct: People who receive the word with joy but have no root and fall away
reading.explain: The rocky-ground seeds represent people who receive the word joyfully but, having no root, fall away when trouble comes.

reading.ru: Разве для того вносят в дом светильник, чтобы поставить его под горшок или под кровать? Наоборот, его ставят на подставку.
reading.question: According to Jesus, what should be done with a lamp?
options: Put it on a stand, not hide it under a bowl or bed
Keep it burning only at night
Hide it in a jar until needed
reading.correct: Put it on a stand, not hide it under a bowl or bed
reading.explain: Jesus says a lamp is not brought in to be put under a bowl or bed but is placed on a stand.

reading.ru: Какой меры вы мерите, такой будет отмерено и вам, и даже прибавлено.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about the measure people use?
options: The measure they use will be measured back to them, with more added
It has no effect on them
reading.correct: The measure they use will be measured back to them, with more added
reading.explain: Jesus says with the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more added.

reading.ru: Он и сам не знает как, ведь земля сама дает плод.
reading.question: In the parable of the growing seed, how does the seed grow?
options: The earth produces the crop by itself, without the man understanding how
The man works the soil constantly
It grows only after rain sent by an angel
It needs to be replanted every night
reading.correct: The earth produces the crop by itself, without the man understanding how
reading.explain: The man does not know how, for the earth produces the crop all by itself.

reading.ru: Оно, как горчичное зерно. Когда его сеют в землю, оно самое маленькое из всех семян, но когда вырастает, то становится больше всех огородных растений
reading.question: How does Jesus describe the mustard seed?
options: It is the smallest of seeds but grows larger than all garden plants
It is the largest of all seeds
reading.correct: It is the smallest of seeds but grows larger than all garden plants
reading.explain: Jesus says the mustard seed is the smallest of all seeds, yet grows to become larger than all garden plants.

reading.ru: Проснувшись, он запретил ветру и приказал озеру. «Умолкни!» «Перестань!» В тот же момент ветер стих и наступил полный штиль.
reading.question: What did Jesus do when he woke up during the storm?
options: He rebuked the wind and sea, and the storm became completely calm
He told the disciples to swim to shore
He asked the disciples to row harder
reading.correct: He rebuked the wind and sea, and the storm became completely calm
reading.explain: Jesus woke, rebuked the wind and the sea, saying 'Be still!', and the wind stopped, bringing a great calm.
